params.prompt: Use the attached reference image of this character: keep his face, hair, body shape, outfit and colors exactly consistent with it. Create a clean 3D-modeling reference turnaround of the same character in color: four full-body views of him side by side in one row, evenly spaced, all at exactly the same scale, standing on one shared ground line, with wide empty white margins between the figures so nothing touches or overlaps: 1) front view, 2) left side view with the character facing the left edge of the image, 3) back view, 4) right side view with the character facing the right edge of the image. Orthographic camera at chest height, no perspective distortion. Strict A-pose for 3D rigging: standing perfectly straight, feet a little wider than shoulder-width apart and pointing forward, legs straight and clearly separated with a visible gap between the thighs, both arms raised away from the body at about 45 degrees from the torso, elbows straight, hands open and flat with fingers spread apart and palms facing down, so there is a large clear gap between each arm and the torso and hips; the hands are far away from the thighs; nothing in the hands. The shoulder-length hair hangs straight down behind the ears and does not cover the face. Neutral relaxed expression with a closed mouth. The character is a 36-year-old Korean man, a former professional MMA bantamweight who runs his own gym: 170 cm, about 7.3 heads tall with realistic proportions, a lean wiry fighter build with solid rounded shoulders, a thick neck, a narrow waist, defined but not bulky arms. Light warm skin. A long oval face with defined cheekbones and a firm jaw, narrow single-lidded eyes, straight dark eyebrows, a straight nose, a black moustache and a short goatee with light stubble along the jaw. Straight black shoulder-length hair tucked behind the ears. Outfit: a plain muted olive-khaki short-sleeved gym t-shirt (#67684F), black compression arm sleeves on both arms from under the t-shirt sleeves to the wrists (#262628), plain black loose training pants (#2A2A2C) without stripes, bare feet. Plain unbranded clothing. Rendering: flat even studio lighting from the front with almost no cast shadows and no shadow on the ground, flat muted anime cel colors with only a very light single shadow tone, clean thin dark outlines, pure plain white background, no ground line. Avoid: perspective, dramatic lighting, hands touching the body, arms hanging down, crossed legs, props held in the hands, extra characters, text, letters, labels, grid lines, numbers, logos, watermarks, cigarettes, alcohol.
